title: Listed coordinate becomes monotone
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $is$ be any finite list of coordinates, and let $j$ be a coordinate appearing in $is$. After successively polarizing $f$ along $is$, the resulting function is monotone in coordinate $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
An arbitrary finite list of coordinates
A coordinate $j$ that belongs to the list
